item.title: Senate To Engage IMF On Nigeria’s Economic Outlook, Tinubu’s Reforms
item.description: The Senate will meet IMF officials to discuss Nigeria’s economic outlook and the Tinubu administration’s reform agenda.

item.title: Nigeria, EU Conclude Nuclear Safety Cooperation Project
item.description: Nigeria has concluded a two-and-a-half-year nuclear safety cooperation project with the European Union to strengthen regulatory capacity.

item.title: HYPREP Reaffirms Commitment To Ogoniland Environmental Restoration
item.description: HYPREP has reaffirmed commitment to restoring Ogoniland’s oil-polluted environment and sustaining the ongoing cleanup efforts.

item.title: OPEC: Nigeria’s Crude Oil Production Fell 10% To 1.31m bpd In February
item.description: Nigeria’s crude oil production declined by 10% to 1.31 million barrels per day in February, according to OPEC.

item.title: Tinubu Approves Procurement Of Military Hardware To Boost Anti-Terror Operations
item.description: President Tinubu approves fresh military equipment procurement as security forces intensify operations against insurgents and terrorist groups nationwide.

item.title: Aiyedatiwa Dismisses Court Ruling Barring Him From Re-Election Bid
item.description: Ondo Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa says court judgment barring him from another term is premature, insisting he never declared interest in re-election.

item.title: World Glaucoma Day: Fubara Urges Rivers Residents To Prioritise Eye Health
item.description: Rivers Governor Siminalayi Fubara urges residents to undergo glaucoma screening to prevent avoidable blindness.

item.title: Nigerian Air Force Destroys Four Terrorists’ Gun Trucks In Sambisa Strike
item.description: Nigerian Air Force destroys four terrorists’ gun trucks during intelligence-led air interdiction operation in Sambisa Forest.

item.title: Israel Launches Wide-Scale Strikes On Tehran As Iran Fires Missiles
item.description: Israel launches wide-scale strikes on Tehran as Iran fires missiles, drones are intercepted, and regional tensions surge rapidly.

item.title: Rapper-Turned Politician Balen Shah Leads Party To Historic Nepal Election Victory
item.description: Nepal’s Rastriya Swatantra Party secures sweeping election victory, ending decades of establishment dominance and ushering in a new political era.
